candidates.change_summary: Remove the ownership check so any caller can trigger the transfer.
Remove the zero-address check so transfers to address(0) are attempted.
Remove the positive-amount check so zero-value calls no longer revert.
Replace transfer with a low-level call so failures no longer revert.
Remove the require(msg.sender == owner) check so anyone can call sendTo.
Invert the owner check to msg.sender != owner so only non-owners can call sendTo.
Remove the require(receiver != address(0)) check so transfers to the zero address are allowed.
Invert the receiver check to receiver == address(0) so all calls revert except transfers to the zero address.
Remove the require(amount > 0) check so zero-amount transfers are allowed.
Invert the amount check to amount == 0 so calls with nonzero amounts revert while zero transfers succeed.
Send the funds to owner instead of the given receiver.
Delete the transfer statement so sendTo performs no ether transfer at all.
Remove the require(msg.sender == owner) access check so anyone can call sendTo.
Remove the require(receiver != address(0)) check so transfers to the zero address no longer revert.
Remove the require(amount > 0) check so zero-amount transfers no longer revert.
Transfer one wei less than the requested amount.
Removed the require(msg.sender == owner) check so any caller can trigger the transfer.
Inverted the zero-address check to require(receiver == address(0)), making legitimate calls revert.
Removed the transfer statement so no ether is ever sent to the receiver.
Replaced transfer(amount) with transfer(1) so the receiver always gets exactly 1 wei regardless of amount.
Changed the amount guard from amount > 0 to amount >= 0, allowing a transfer of 0 (which reverts-transfer semantics differ from the require on 0 amount).
